title: Ilumina DNA Prep Part 1 - Tagment DNA
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Configure protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Specify the Number of samples for the run; set the P300 tip start column on Slot 8 (choose a column 1‑12); select the side (left or right) for the P20 Multi‑Channel GEN2 mount; select the side (left or right) for the P300 Multi‑Channel GEN2 mount.

steps.title: Add water to plate
steps.instruction: Dispense 10 µL of water into each column of the empty 96‑well Bio‑Rad 200 µL plate located in Slot 3, up to the number of samples specified.

steps.title: Premix DNA and transfer
steps.instruction: Pipette the DNA sample and perform 10 repetitive mixing actions (premix). Then transfer 5 µL of the premixed DNA into each column of the plate in Slot 3 that already contains water.

steps.title: Mix DNA and water
steps.instruction: Mix the DNA‑water mixture in each column to ensure homogeneity.

steps.title: Add mastermix to mixture
steps.instruction: For every set of up to three columns, premix the required volume of mastermix, then add the mastermix to the corresponding DNA‑water mixtures.
